title: Apply rate limiting across all API routes and add global middleware
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiting middleware applied globally via Next.js middleware or per-route wrapper
Rate limit tiers: authenticated users (higher limits), anonymous (lower limits), API keys (custom)
Rate limit storage: in-memory sliding window for MVP, Redis-ready interface for production
All /api/* routes have rate limiting configured
Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset) on every response
429 responses include Retry-After header and descriptive error body
Rate limit config DRY — single source of truth for limits
